en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a gently sloping street in a small European town. On the left stands a large multi‑storey building with steep gabled roofs and many windows, partly hidden by tall trees along the roadside. On the right side of the street are continuous rows of older townhouses. Several people can be seen walking further down the road. In the far background are low, forested hills. The caption "JÖHSTADT i. Erzgeb." is printed in white in the lower left corner.
